Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:
If a Gangrel has Ablative Skin, and gets
in Combat with a Tremere who (for saftey
reasons buggers off to long range) and
plays Soul Burn, can the Gangrel burn the
Ablative Skin counters to prevent the
damage, or do they count as a preventative
measure from a Fortitude Card?

Andy "Slytherin" Brown
VEKN Setite Ruler of Cambridge

Messages.Body:



Soul Burn:
Clarifications and Rulings

Cannot be used to prevent damage that cannot be prevented by cards
that require Fortitude (e.g., Blood Rage and Blood Fury). [LSJ
19990216]
